posts.zh:
dsh-model-sync 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-951f13904bcc255b110d.html
posts.en:
dsh-model-sync is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-951f13904bcc255b110d.html
